format: mcanouil-typst
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: poster
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: An unknown type stops the render and names the known types.
        errors: strict
    mcanouil-typst:
      shouldError: true
      printsMessage:
        level: ERROR
        regex: 'mcanouil: unknown type "poster"; use article, invoice, letter, memo, report\.'
